name: Call of Duty OG Music Pack
teaser: Adds the Music from all 3 older MW games COD4, MW2, and MW3.
description_html:
WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL. ALT SOLUTION: Download the ZIP files from my link in Bobby’s Mod Page and then unzip them to a folder or desktop

This Music Mod adds all 3 games of the old COD series OST to SPT. COD4, MW2 and MW3. I have a separate pack for Black Ops ready to upload as well which I will try to get to before the night is up.

Install instructions: Drag BepinEx folder into SPT directory

Updated to SPT 3.10.x versions. Enjoy!

Updated to SPT 3.11 version follow mod instructions above
